author: Synthetic Generator
content:
In this fictional follow-up scenario, Super Micro Computer reported that a customer completed initial acceptance testing of the Vera Rubin NVL72 racks shipped under its recently announced program.

The earlier shipment announcement covered direct liquid-cooled racks with 72 NVIDIA Rubin GPUs and 36 Vera CPUs each. The newly reported acceptance testing is a later milestone for that same shipment program, rather than a separate product launch.

Super Micro said the customer signed off on the first installed rack after validating the cooling and networking integration. Further rack installations are still planned, and no gigawatt-scale facility is claimed to be fully operational.

The new acceptance milestone adds a development to the original shipment news without changing the announced rack configuration.
headline: Super Micro completes first gigawatt-scale Vera Rubin deployment at US research site
summary: Following initial shipments, Super Micro confirmed the installation of a gigawatt-scale Vera Rubin cluster.
